snippet.title: Walk of Life - Trailer
snippet.description:
Walk of Life is a hilarious life simulator where players duke it out in the rat race of mundane living. Jaw-dropping features include getting a job, educating yourself, and buying stuff. Take on your friends or enemies in couch co-op or online and become champion in the ultimate game of life! 

💥 Coming out in 2025 💥 Wishlist now! 🙏

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1910150/Walk_of_Life/

Discord: https://discord.gg/4dzzMryWBe
